CommonResult.description:
Unified API response format.

All API responses follow this structure:
- code: 0 for success, non-zero for errors
- msg: Human-readable message in Chinese
- data: Response payload (can be any type)
CommonResult.title: CommonResult

post.description:
Local username/password login.

Rules per FP-D01-01:
- User not exist or wrong password -> 1214 (same message)
- 5 consecutive failures -> lock 15 minutes, return 1215
- FROZEN/RESIGNED -> 1216 (after password check)
- Tenant disabled/expired -> 1008
- Success: clear count, write last_login_time/ip, create session, write login log
- Non-existent username also counts failures (prevent enumeration)

Logout current session.

Rules per FP-D01-04:
- Delete current session
- Add access token sid to blacklist (TTL = remaining time)

get.description:
Get current user's info, menus, and permissions.

Rules per FP-D06-01:
- Menu tree = tenant package menus ∩ enabled role menus
- permCodes from all enabled roles
- dataScopeText in Chinese (e.g., "本部门（市场一部、市场二部）")
- PENDING_CONFIG or empty permissions -> empty menus with prompt

post.description:
Refresh access token.

Rules per FP-D01-03:
- Valid refresh -> new access + new refresh (old refresh invalidated)
- Invalid/expired/reused refresh -> 1002 (HTTP 401)

get.description:
DingTalk SSO callback.

Rules per FP-D02-02:
- state not exist/expired/used -> 1002 (GETDEL atomic)
- Use authCode to get DingTalk userid + phone
- Match: ims_auth_user_mapping.dingtalk_user_id -> mobile_hash
- No match -> 1217, no token issued
- FROZEN/RESIGNED -> 1216
- Success: issue tokens, 302 to /sso-callback#accessToken=...&refreshToken=...&redirect=...

DingTalk SSO redirect.

Rules per FP-D02-01:
- Generate 32-char random state, store in Redis 5 min (with redirect)
- redirect must be site-relative path, otherwise replace with /
- DingTalk not configured -> 1008

Return specified error code for testing.

LOGIN_ONLY - for B0b request layer example page to verify error handling.
Only available in test environment.

put.description:
Confirm keeping a local orphan department.

Rules per FP-D07-02 item 7:
- Sets local_orphan=0, marking dept as confirmed to keep
- Only applicable to departments with local_orphan=1

post.description:
Create a local department.

Rules per FP-B08-04:
- source=LOCAL
- Parent not exist -> 1500, disabled -> 1501
- Same-parent duplicate name -> 1219
- Under "待分配" -> 1220

delete.description:
Delete department.

Rules per FP-B08-07:
- Has children or users (any status including resigned) -> 1502
- SYSTEM dept -> 1220

put.description:
Move department to new parent.

Rules per FP-B08-06:
- Move to self or descendant -> 1218
- DINGTALK to LOCAL parent -> 1220
- SYSTEM dept cannot move or be target -> 1220
- Same-parent duplicate name -> 1219
- Same transaction update all descendant paths

get.description:
Get department tree.

Rules per FP-B08-02:
- memberCount: dedup count of active+frozen users in dept and all descendants
- directMemberCount: users directly in this dept
- keyword match: return matched node and ancestor path
- Default excludes disabled depts, status=ALL includes them
- Tree itself not filtered by data scope (org structure is public)
- Performance: 2000 depts, 20k users -> <= 500ms

put.description:
Update department (name, leader, sort).

Rules per FP-B08-05:
- SYSTEM dept -> 1220
- Same-parent duplicate name -> 1219
- DINGTALK dept: success with syncOverrideHint=true

Enable or disable department.

Rules per FP-B08-07:
- Has enabled children -> 1502
- SYSTEM dept -> 1220
- DINGTALK dept: local disable allowed, next sync may re-enable

get.description:
Get enabled dictionary values for a type.

Rules per FP-B07-03:
- Returns enabled values only
- Includes colorType
- Cached in Redis (ims:dict:<type>), TTL 60s local cache

Get the latest org sync batch status.

Rules per FP-D07-04:
- Returns the most recent sync batch
- Includes counts for dept/user changes

post.description:
Trigger organization structure reconciliation with DingTalk.

Rules per FP-D07-04:
- Compares IMS org structure with DingTalk
- Creates sync batch record
- Returns immediately with batch info (async execution)

get.description:
Get enabled roles for selectors.

LOGIN_ONLY - returns id, name, source only.

post.description:
Create a new user.

Minimal fields: username, nickname, mobile, depts, mainDeptId, password.
Full user management is in M02 module.

delete.description:
Delete user.

Rules per FP-B03-01 item 3:
- Only users who never logged in AND have no business references can be deleted
- RESIGNED users cannot be deleted -> 1502

get.description:
Get paginated user list.

Rules per FP-B08-03:
- includeChildren=true: filter by path LIKE '/…/deptId/%'
- includeChildren=false: only direct members
- Data scope filtering applied

Get simple user list for selectors.

LOGIN_ONLY - returns id, nickname, mainDeptName, status only.

put.description:
Update user's department assignments.

Rules per FP-B03-02:
- User can belong to multiple departments
- Must have exactly one main department
- Removing main dept requires specifying another main first
- Removing all depts auto-assigns to "待分配" dept

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns system health status. Does not expose any connection strings.
